newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Petroecuador says YPF oil well capped after spill.
newsitem.headline: Petroecuador says YPF oil well capped after spill.

text.p: A fissure in a disused oil well drilled by Argentina's YPF SA that caused a minor spill of crude in the northern Amazon jungle of Ecuador has been capped, state-owned Petroecuador said Wednesday.
"One can't talk about a huge spill because the oil is extra heavy," a spokesman for the company said.

High-pressure gas seemed to have burst through the concrete that sealed the old well, which was drilled by YPF in 1987 in the province of Sucumbios, 200 km (120 miles) north of Quito on the border with Colombia.
Petroecuador was carrying out some clean-up work in the area, even though it has no responsibility for the problem, the spokesman said, adding YPF would take care of repairs.
